purpose.zh: 腿往侧面滑到最远时练大腿内侧的控制，帮助横叉
purpose.en: Train inner-thigh control as your leg slides far out to the side, helping your side splits.

text.zh: 腿伸直往侧面滑出，再用大腿内侧拉回
text.en: Slide the straight leg out to the side, then pull it back with your inner thigh

text.zh: 一只脚踩滑垫，另一侧膝盖弯、臀部往后坐。
text.en: Put one foot on the slider, bend the other knee and sit your hips back.

text.zh: 滑到能控制的距离停住，不要硬撑。
text.en: Stop at a distance you can control; do not force it.

commonErrors.en: Sliding too far and losing control.
Letting the standing knee cave in.

cautions.zh: 大腿内侧或膝盖疼时滑近一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your inner thigh or knee hurts, slide less far, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: purpose「侧向开腿末端的主动控制」改口语
口令「向侧滑出」→「滑出去」，「Pull back in」→「Pull back」
flags: 派生顶点 ≥0.8 s 判为 rep_hold，但 spec 注释里真正的停顿只有约 0.6 s，若按实际应为 rep_updown，请确认
